question: 2025年园区综合能耗是多少吨标准煤？
oracle_sql: select round(engine.metric_value('ENG_TCE', node_id, 2025, 'GIP_2026'), 1) as v from core.org_node where code = 'XYEDZ'

question: 2025年园区碳排放总量是多少（GIP_2026口径）？
oracle_sql: select round(engine.metric_value('CO2_TOTAL', node_id, 2025, 'GIP_2026'), 1) as v from core.org_node where code = 'XYEDZ'

question: 2024年园区综合能耗比2023年增长了百分之多少？
oracle_sql: select round((engine.metric_value('ENG_TCE', node_id, 2024, 'GIP_2026') / engine.metric_value('ENG_TCE', node_id, 2023, 'GIP_2026') - 1) * 100, 1) as v from core.org_node where code = 'XYEDZ'

question: 按2026版绿色工业园区评价要求，2025年园区有几项指标达标？
oracle_sql: select count(*) as v from fact.indicator_value v join core.indicator_def d using (indicator_id) join core.standard_version s on s.version_id = d.version_id join core.org_node n on n.node_id = v.node_id where s.code = 'GIP_2026' and n.code = 'XYEDZ' and v.is_current and v.achieved and v.period_start = '2025-01-01'

question: 2025年园区能源产出率（GIP_2026 指标 I04）是多少？
oracle_sql: select round(v.value, 2) as v from fact.indicator_value v join core.indicator_def d using (indicator_id) join core.standard_version s on s.version_id = d.version_id join core.org_node n on n.node_id = v.node_id where s.code = 'GIP_2026' and d.code = 'I04' and n.code = 'XYEDZ' and v.is_current and v.period_start = '2025-01-01'

question: 2025年哪家企业单位工业总产值能耗最高？是多少 tce/万元？
oracle_sql: select round(max(engine.metric_value('ENG_TCE', node_id, 2025, 'GIP_2026') / nullif(engine.stat_value('ECO_GROSS_OUTPUT', node_id, 2025, ''), 0)), 4) as v from core.org_node where node_type = 'enterprise' and is_active

question: 2025年园区电网电力折合多少吨标准煤？
oracle_sql: select round(sum(case a.flow when 'send_out' then -a.tce else a.tce end), 1) as v from fact.energy_activity a where a.is_current and a.energy_type_code = 'ELEC_GRID' and a.flow in ('consumption','receive','send_out') and extract(year from a.period_month) = 2025 and a.node_id in (select engine.accounting_nodes(node_id) from core.org_node where code = 'XYEDZ')

question: 河南省2023年电网电力二氧化碳排放因子是多少？
oracle_sql: select value as v from core.factor where energy_type_code = 'ELEC_GRID' and factor_kind = 'co2_per_unit' and variant = 'henan' and extract(year from valid_from) = 2023 and status = 'approved'

question: 谷麦光电2022年是不是高新技术企业？证书编号是多少？
2025年全国碳市场配额（CEA）全年平均收盘价是多少？
oracle_sql: select round(avg(close_price), 2) as v from fact.carbon_market_price where is_current and market_code = 'CEA' and extract(year from trade_date) = 2025

question: CCER 最近一个交易日的成交均价是多少？
oracle_sql: select avg_price as v from fact.carbon_market_price where is_current and market_code = 'CCER' order by trade_date desc limit 1

question: 2025年园区综合能耗超出年度预算百分之多少？
oracle_sql: select round((engine.metric_value('ENG_TCE', t.node_id, 2025, 'GIP_2026') / t.value - 1) * 100, 2) as v from fact.target t join core.org_node n using (node_id) where n.code = 'XYEDZ' and t.is_current and t.target_kind = 'energy_budget_tce' and t.year = 2025

question: 碳达峰路线图中，低碳情景下园区碳排放峰值是多少吨？
oracle_sql: select round((params -> 'scenarios' -> 'ROADMAP_LOWCARBON' ->> 'peak_co2_t')::numeric, 0) as v from fact.calc_run where run_type = 'forecast' and status = 'succeeded' and params ->> 'model' = 'scenario-roadmap' order by run_id desc limit 1

question: 2025年万华生态（信阳）的碳排放是多少吨？
oracle_sql: select round(engine.metric_value('CO2_TOTAL', node_id, 2025, 'GIP_2026'), 1) as v from core.org_node where code = 'E_WANHUA'

question: 2023年哪家企业对园区综合能耗增长的贡献最大？增加了多少吨标准煤？
oracle_sql: select round(max(engine.metric_value('ENG_TCE', node_id, 2023, 'GIP_2026') - engine.metric_value('ENG_TCE', node_id, 2022, 'GIP_2026')), 0) as v from core.org_node where node_type = 'enterprise' and is_active

question: 2025年园区工业增加值（不变价）是多少万元？
oracle_sql: select round(engine.metric_value('ECO_VA_CONST', node_id, 2025, 'GIP_2026'), 0) as v from core.org_node where code = 'XYEDZ'

question: 永豪轩2019年的工业总产值是多少？
oracle_sql: select s.value as v from fact.statistic_value s join core.org_node n using (node_id) where n.code = 'E_YONGHAOXUAN' and s.is_current and s.metric_code = 'ECO_GROSS_OUTPUT' and s.period_start = '2019-01-01'

question: 2025年园区天然气消费量是多少立方米？
oracle_sql: select round(sum(a.quantity_std), 0) as v from fact.energy_activity a where a.is_current and a.energy_type_code = 'NATURAL_GAS' and a.flow = 'consumption' and extract(year from a.period_month) = 2025 and a.node_id in (select engine.accounting_nodes(node_id) from core.org_node where code = 'XYEDZ')
